classification.rationale: Knit polyester pile fabric imitating fur is a knit pile fabric (heading 6001), not artificial fur (ch.43 note 5), so a knitted jacket falls in 6102; the bonded leather layer triggers the special leather line 6102.30.05 (assuming 25% or more by weight). HQ 965713 classifies garments of bonded knit fabric by the knit fabric.
